answer: Reaching eligibility takes 82 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The echo register is checked at draw time, sparrow lists the eligible set, and vertex seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 82 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 166 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
